instruction: Turn off the auto-save feature in LibreOffice Impress to rely on manual saving only

metadata.explanation: Task asks to disable auto-save feature. The evaluator checks the AutoSave property is set to false in the LibreOffice configuration file.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly retrieves LibreOffice configuration file where auto-save settings are stored
Metric logic correctly parses XML and navigates to the right path (/org.openoffice.Office.Common/Save/Document)
Metric correctly extracts AutoSave property and compares against expected state
Expected value (enabled=false) semantically matches the instruction requirement to 'turn off' auto-save
Complete coverage: instruction has one requirement (disable auto-save), evaluator checks exactly that
Edge case handling: metric returns 0.0 if AutoSave property is missing, which is reasonable behavior
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider adding postconfig to close LibreOffice to ensure settings are flushed to disk before verification (though LibreOffice typically writes settings immediately)
Minor: Could add more detailed logging to distinguish between 'AutoSave=true' vs 'AutoSave property missing' cases for better debugging
